claims.evidence: PRIDE organisms NEWT:9606; antibodies are SiluLite SigmaMAb human IgG standard and trastuzumab (humanized IgG1) per PRIDE protocol. Antibody identity itself is encoded only in source name.

claims.value: SiluLite|Trastuzumab _ protease (one source per antibody x protease digest)
claims.evidence: Raw-header sample string e.g. 'SiluLite L-Dimethyl Trypsin 2' gives antibody, label, protease, suffix; cross-validated: merged mgf TITLEs for SiLu_DimL list LUM_02287-90,303-305,312-314, SiLu_DimM 295-98,309,310,318,323,325,326, Trastuzumab_DimL 291-94,306-08,315-17,322, Trastuzumab_DimM 299-302,311,319,320,324,327 (0 conflicts). Round-2 redesign: PRIDE protocol says each digest was split in two for light/medium labelling, so light and medium runs share one source and are distinguished by comment[label].

claims.location: comment[cleavage agent details], factor value[cleavage agent details]
claims.evidence: Protease in raw sample string; PRIDE protocol lists the same four enzymes. The Mascot search used Enzyme=None (see limitations).

PRIDE protocol: light = formaldehyde, intermediate = formaldehyde-d2 with NaBH3CN; Mascot fixed mod Dimethyl (+28.0313) for Dim L and Dimethyl:2H(4) (+32.0564) for Dim M. Each run contains a single label (not multiplexed).

claims.value: Carbamidomethyl C fixed; Dimethyl (or Dimethyl:2H(4)) K and Any N-term fixed; Oxidation M, Deamidated N,Q, Dioxidation W, Gln->pyro-Glu, Glu->pyro-Glu variable
claims.evidence: Mascot SearchModification blocks of the four .mzid files. Dimethyl N-term has residues='' + N-term specificity -> PP=Any N-term. Pyro-Glu N-term -> PP=Peptide N-term (mzid gives N-term specificity only).
Raw header strings 'Orbitrap Fusion Lumos' and 'Orbitrap_Lumos'; PRIDE instruments agrees.
Method name 'HCD_Top10_...' (Top10 DDA with targeted MS3 of a1 ion).

claims.location: comment[dissociation method], comment[collision energy], comment[ms3 scan range]
claims.evidence: Scan filter 'ms3 437.77@hcd30.00 114.13@hcd30.00 [50.0000-125.0000]'. PRIDE text says CID; raw scan filter says HCD, raw taken as authoritative. 30 NCE is the stated @hcd30.00 value for both MS2 and MS3 steps.

claims.location: comment[precursor mass tolerance], comment[fragment mass tolerance]
claims.evidence: PRIDE dataProcessingProtocol and mzid search tolerance 10 / 0.05.
PRIDE sampleProcessingProtocol: 10 mM DTT 56C; 20 mM IAA; consistent with fixed Carbamidomethyl in search.

claims.value: bio replicate 1; technical replicate = acquisition-ordered run counter per source (1..N across both labels)
claims.evidence: PRIDE protocol describes one digest per antibody/protease (no replicate digests), so biological replicate = 1. Raw-header suffixes (none/1/2/3) are NOT interpreted as biological replicates; each additional run of the same digest gets the next technical replicate number (counter spans both labels because the community row coordinate omits label). Whether suffix runs are repeat injections or repeat preparations is unknown.
Purified commercial/therapeutic antibody standards; no donor. age not available (not applicable not permitted by template); the rest not applicable.

limitations: Paper full text not retrievable (closed access); only abstract used. Sample prep from PRIDE protocol text.

Per-run protease taken from the raw-file sample-name string (not described in a deposited sample sheet). Mascot search used Enzyme=None, so it does not corroborate it; PRIDE reconcile flags Thermolysin and Pepsin against 'Trypsin, Chymotrypsin' but the PRIDE protocol text names all four enzymes (false positive).
Antibody identity (SiluLite vs trastuzumab) has no template column; encoded in source name only.
Deposited peak lists, mzid, mztab and csv files are not SDRF rows (41 RAW only).
Carbamidomethyl, reagents and tolerances are shared across runs from PRIDE/mzid, not per-run verified; cysteine-bearing peptide search params only available for the four merged searches.

Technical replicate numbers are a per-source run counter, not an observed replicate structure; raw-name suffixes (none/1/2/3) might denote independent preparations, but the PRIDE protocol describes one digest per antibody/protease.
Light and medium runs of one digest share a source; the two label tables were built separately (comment[modification parameters] differs by label) and merged.

Acquisition method string in raw headers is 'Gradient_90min_2column_ETD+HCD_Top10_JABdelight_v5_1micro.meth'; HCD annotation rests on MS3/MS2 scan filters (@hcd30.00); PRIDE text says CID; ETD scans cannot be excluded though Mascot searched a/b/y ions only.
PP=Any N-term (dimethyl) and PP=Peptide N-term (pyro-Glu) are inferred from Mascot N-term specificity with empty residues.
